title: Ship and review on a GitLab project: /work-card ends in gh pr create
notes: /work-card ends with `gh pr create`, and the review after it (the pull request number on the card, the review sweep, pr land) goes through gh. On a project whose remote is GitLab (insta-experiences), the agent does the work, pushes, then gets 'none of the git remotes configured for this repository point to a known GitHub host'. The card stays in Doing with no pull request and no review. Fix: glab mr create and /mr-loop when the remote is a GitLab host, and record a merge request on the card the way a pull request is recorded. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/354 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/353#discussion_r4679307570

comments.body: This card is GitHub issue #354; the PR says Closes #354. #353 added the remote-not-origin work: build on its chosen remote; /mr-loop is in the claude-pr-loop repo, installed in ~/.claude.

Round 2: comments now say forge instead of gh, and an unused export was dropped. Final check accepted both last commits. CI passed on c42f75f1. No change to the card's scope or design.
